observations.content: Deployments are allowed Monday through Thursday between 9am and 4pm ET only
No deployments on Fridays — full deploy freeze for weekend stability
Hotfixes bypass the deploy window but require VP-eng approval
All deploys must pass staging validation before production push
Core payment processing service handling Stripe integration
Last deploy was Tuesday, no incidents reported since
Currently on v3.2.1, next release v3.3.0 includes refund flow improvements
